=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:17 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: review_head_gate_post_status (line 17) compares REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED only against the exact string "false". The last run changed review_head_gate_updater_exempt (lines 110-119, `ue_status_flag,,`) and the verify_head_gate step in .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml (`gate_status_flag,,`, lines 2496-2504) to read it without regard to case, so the same kill switch is read two ways.
  WHY: With the value "False" or "FALSE" on an updater PR, review_head_gate_main (lines 187/189) still posts ai-review/head-gate=pending. Every success path then returns reason=status_disabled and posts nothing, so the gate stays pending, which is the #9483 stall this PR fixes. It also inverts the README.md:185 statement that "false disables status writes". All 4 reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low. Suggested fix: `local status_flag="${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED:-true}"; if [ "${status_flag,,}" = "false" ]`.
- README.md:137 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED` row still describes the pre-#9483 behaviour ("otherwise the PR waits for a human and the run logs a warning"). It does not mention the new verify_merge_blocked step, which logs `::error::UPDATER_PR_VERIFY outcome=merge_blocked reason=auto_merge_failed`, sends a Telegram alert and exits 1 (.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2625-2662).
  WHY: Operators reading the variable reference are not told that a blocked auto-merge now fails the job and sends an alert, so the documented contract and the shipped behaviour disagree. The new contract appears only in changelog.d/agents.d fragments. minimax rated it NIT (mapped to low); gemini gave no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR's documented contract (README variable reference; PR description's fix 2) must describe the new merge-blocked behavior: "When auto-merge cannot be enabled, fail the job loudly and alert, instead of logging a warning."
  expected_change_site: README.md, `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED` row (line 137)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in README.md updates the `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED` row; it still reads "otherwise the PR waits for a human and the run logs a warning", while .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml step `verify_merge_blocked` now logs `::error::UPDATER_PR_VERIFY outcome=merge_blocked reason=auto_merge_failed`, sends a Telegram alert and exits 1; the new failure contract is documented only in changelog.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md and agents.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:Line 17, `if [ "${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED}" = "false" ]` in review_head_gate_post_status (vs lines 110-119 in review_head_gate_updater_exempt; verify_head_gate step in .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run made the updater exemption and the verify-job re-check read REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED without regard to case. review_head_gate_post_status still matches only the exact lowercase "false", so the readings disagree for "False" and "FALSE".
  WHY: With REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED=FALSE on an updater PR, review_head_gate_main (lines 187/189) posts pending. All success paths return reason=status_disabled: review_head_gate_main line 205, the review_enable_auto_merge.sh updater branch, the review_rb_judge.sh updater_verify_hold branch, and verify_head_gate. The gate therefore stays pending (the #9483 stall), and the last run introduced this mismatch. Fix: lowercased defaulted local at line 17.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_head_gate.sh review_head_gate_post_status, line 17. Use `local status_flag="${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED:-true}"` followed by `if [ "${status_flag,,}" = "false" ]; then` (2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All four #9483 fixes are present. The `[ -n "${GATE_HEAD_REF:-}" ]` guard was checked: scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh line 1644 writes `head_ref=${pr_head_ref}`, and review_autofix.yml line 749 passes it as GATE_HEAD_REF.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- README.md:137 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The documentation for UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED still describes the pre-#9483 behavior (logs a warning, waits for human) and does not mention the new loud failure/alert behavior.
  WHY: Operators may not be aware that the job now fails and alerts, leading to confusion when an updater PR stalls.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:line 17 (`if [ "${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED}" = "false" ]`) versus lines 111-119 (`ue_status_flag`, lowercased) and .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2496-2504 (`gate_status_flag`, lowercased) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both new exemption paths read REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_STATUS_ENABLED case-insensitively, but review_head_gate_post_status compares the raw value against the exact string "false".
  WHY: With "False" or "FALSE", pending is still written (review_head_gate_main:187 and :189), while review_head_gate_updater_exempt:116-119 and update_workflows.yml:2501-2504 return status_disabled. The gate stays pending (the #9483 stall), and README.md:185 "false disables status writes" is inverted for those spellings.
- README.md:line 137 (the `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED` row) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The row still says "otherwise the PR waits for a human and the run logs a warning". It does not mention that verify_merge_blocked logs `::error::UPDATER_PR_VERIFY outcome=merge_blocked reason=auto_merge_failed`, sends a Telegram alert and exits 1 (.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2625-2662).
  WHY: The documented contract and the shipped behaviour disagree. The new contract appears only in changelog.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md and agents.d/9483-updater-pr-stall-alarms.md.
- HARDENING (3 related items, each HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1):
  - scripts/review_head_gate.sh line 17: lowercase the defaulted switch, as in the exemption paths (2 lines).
  - .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml verify_head_gate jq filters, lines 2524 and 2563: the integrity context "coding-workflows/workflow-integrity" and the updater branch regex are hardcoded duplicates of scripts/review_head_gate.sh:99-101, and drift between them could reproduce the stall. Fix: pass both through env: and use jq --arg (6 lines).
  - .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml verify_merge_blocked Telegram curl, line 2654: no --max-time, so a stall delays the failure until the 15-minute job timeout (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:156 uses --max-time 30). Fix: add --max-time 30 (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
